name: Takip: yeni takip kutusuna islem/seans ekleme, duzenleme, silme

planSteps.description: Log in with the TEST account credentials configured for this project
Open patient 'TEST Senaryo HASTA', go to the 'Takip' tab and click 'Yeni Takip'
Choose the 'Kanal Tedavisi' template and create the follow-up
Verify a follow-up box appears with three steps and a progress counter showing 0/3
In that box click 'Islem / Seans Ekle', type 'TEST Ek Seans' with a date and click 'Ekle'
Verify the new step appears at the end of the box and the counter shows 0/4
Click the pencil icon on 'TEST Ek Seans', rename it to 'TEST Ek Seans 2' and save
Verify the step name is updated
Mark the first step as completed
Verify the counter shows 1/4 and the step appears struck through
Delete the 'TEST Ek Seans 2' step and confirm
Verify the step is removed and the counter shows 1/3
